# Event Log Catalog (auto-generated -- rendered examples)

> Generated by `tools/gen_event_catalog.py` from `app/routers/matrix_runs.py`. Do not
> hand-edit -- re-run the generator. Every `_append_event` site is enumerated, so coverage
> is complete by construction. A companion `event-log-catalog.csv` has the same rows plus a
> blank `notes` column for review in Excel.

- Event emit sites: **196**
- Distinct event types: **100**

## How to read this

Each event shows a concrete **Admin** line (the real template rendered against one fixed
sample world) and the **Player** line (that event run through the actual serializer
redaction). Sample world: an Orange host (Security Value 6), an MPCP-6 decker (Hardening 2),
a stock **Killer-5** / **Worm-4** on the **Files** subsystem (rating 8). Numbers are
illustrative, not from a live run.

Player-view rules the redaction applies: `gm_only` events are dropped entirely; host system
tests are rebuilt generically (`<Action> -- SUCCESS (Net Successes: N).`) with the Target
Number shown only after Analyze Host reveals that subsystem (hidden here); the running
security tally + host successes are stripped; and IC identity collapses to the decker's
detection level (here **level 2** -- type known, rating hidden).
